title: Season every offering with the covenant salt
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
recipient: the Zadokite priests consecrating the new altar
note: Inside broad ot-ezekiel-v43-18, whose title omits it: priests throw salt on the burnt offerings, as Leviticus 2:13 requires.

title: Purify and consecrate the altar through the prescribed seven-day offerings and anointing
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
recipient: the priests of the new temple
note: Inside broad ot-ezekiel-v43-18: seven days of atonement and cleansing for the altar mirror Exodus 29:36–37; link as Additional Scripture.

title: The ruler worships at the east gate's threshold; the people bow there
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
recipient: the ruler and the people of the land
note: Inside broad ot-ezekiel-v46-1 (title covers only the gate's opening); first pass itemized 46:4–15 (B18 P02314). 46:3 outside candidate list.

title: Nebuchadnezzar's letter calls the nations to praise God
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: 4:37c gives the same circular letter's greeting and purpose (to show there is a God) and reports it sent to all nations.

title: Gabriel tells Daniel why he came to explain the vision
speaker: the angel Gabriel
note: 9:22 opens the same explanation: 'I have just come out to show you understanding.'

title: The king hands Daniel over to destruction under the crowd's pressure
speaker: the king of Babylon
recipient: his companions, before the hostile crowd
note: Royal sentence like first-pass Daniel 6:15 (B18 P02341); the crowds then throw Daniel into the lions' pit (1:31–32).

title: Hosea calls Israel to return to the Lord with a confession
speaker: Hosea, for the Lord
note: 14:4 continues the words Israel is told to take: Assyria will not save us; no more horses or handmade 'gods'.

title: In an evil time the prudent keep silent
speaker: Amos, for the Lord
note: Outside candidate list (context verse): a maxim between the indictment (5:12) and the call to seek good (ot-amos-v5-14).

title: The Lord sends horsemen to patrol the earth
speaker: the Lord (reported by the man among the mountains)
recipient: the horsemen in Zechariah's night vision
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported sending, like ot-zechariah-v6-7 (gray horses sent through the earth); 1:11 reports the patrol completed.

title: Joshua the high priest is charged to keep God's ways and court
speaker: the angel of the Lord, for the Lord Almighty
note: Conditional charge: walk in My ways, keep My commands, guard My court, and you will govern My house. Follows ot-zechariah-v3-4.

title: Sarasar and Arbeseer send to entreat the Lord and ask the priests
speaker: Sarasar, King Arbeseer and his men
recipient: the priests and prophets of the Lord's house
note: Envoys sent to seek the Lord, like ot-2-kings-v22-13; the Greek blurs their fifth-month fasting question, which 7:5 answers.

title: The Lord warns the priests to honor His name
speaker: the Lord through Malachi
note: 2:1 introduces the same charge: 'And now this command is for you, priests.'

title: The Lord challenges the people to test His provision through the dues
speaker: the Lord through Malachi
note: 3:8–9 name what is withheld, the tithes and firstfruits ('you are defrauding Me'), which the 3:10 challenge concerns.

title: The Father anoints Jesus with the Spirit and names Him beloved Son
speaker: God the Father, a voice from the heavens
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Declaration rather than order: the Spirit's anointing (cf. AUD-46-4-16) in Isaiah 42:1's words (first-pass B16 P01992). Mark, Luke parallel.

title: Jesus tells his critics to learn why God desires mercy
speaker: Jesus
note: Widens first-pass B19 P02516 (9:12–13) to the Pharisees' question, as its Mark 2:15–17 and Luke 5:29–32 links already do.

title: Peter proposes making three tents on the mountain
speaker: Peter
note: Parallel of first-pass B20 P02636 (Mark 9:5–6) and P02706 (Luke 9:32–33); the Father's voice (AUD-44-17-5) interrupts it.

title: Jesus directs Peter to pay the temple tax to avoid giving offense
speaker: Jesus
note: 17:24 is the collectors' question that occasions the instruction: 'Does not your Teacher pay the didrachmas?'

title: Jesus teaches on marriage and Moses' permission to divorce
speaker: Jesus
note: The testing question opens the teaching; first pass widened the Mark link to 10:2–12 the same way (B20 P02640).

title: Know the Scriptures and God's power: He is God of the living
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Sadducees, who deny the resurrection
note: Jesus' answer has no record; only the Sadducees' question is linked (S156). Mark 12:24–27 and Luke 20:34–38 parallel it (this batch).

title: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus' body
speaker: Joseph of Arimathea
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Parallel of first-pass B20 P02668 (Mark 15:42–46), whose note names it; here Pilate orders the body given.

title: The Father anoints Jesus with the Spirit and names Him beloved Son
speaker: God the Father, a voice from the heavens
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Parallel of the Matthew 3:16–17 finding in this batch; here addressed to Jesus: 'Thou art My beloved Son.'

title: The Twelve go out proclaiming that people should repent
speaker: the Twelve
recipient: the people of the towns they visit
note: Reported call to repent, like first-pass Matthew 3:1–2 and Acts 26:19–20; carries out K096/K097. Luke 9:6 is similar.

title: Jesus sends the Twelve to proclaim the kingdom and heal freely
speaker: Jesus
note: Outside candidate list: Mark's account of the sending, two by two with authority over unclean spirits; K097 already holds 6:8–11.

title: Know the Scriptures and God's power: He is God of the living
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Sadducees, who deny the resurrection
note: Parallel of the Matthew 22:29–32 finding in this batch; first pass links the question (12:18–23) to S156.

title: Love God with heart, soul, mind, and strength
speaker: Jesus
note: The scribe's question 'Which commandment is first of all?' opens it; first pass linked Matthew 22:34–38 likewise (B20 P02573).

title: God sends the angel Gabriel to Mary in Nazareth
speaker: God
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Sending of an angel, like first-pass Daniel 8:16 (B18 P02345); first pass widens AUD-46-1-30 back only to 1:28. Luke 1:19 likewise unrecorded.

title: The Father anoints Jesus with the Spirit and names Him beloved Son
speaker: God the Father, a voice from heaven
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Parallel of the Matthew 3:16–17 finding in this batch; the Spirit descends 'in bodily form' as Jesus prays.

title: Report what Jesus is doing
speaker: Jesus
note: John sends two disciples with the question that Jesus' charge answers; first pass linked Matthew 11:2–6 the same way (B20 P02528).

title: Count the cost: the Son of Man has nowhere to rest
speaker: Jesus
note: Parallel of first-pass B19 P02511 (Matthew 8:19–20), whose note flags this verse; K038 begins at 9:59.

title: Receiving Jesus' sent one means receiving him
speaker: Jesus
note: Same saying as Matthew 10:40 and John 13:20, here also negative: whoever rejects you rejects Me and the One who sent Me.

title: Jesus gives the seventy-two authority over snakes, scorpions and the enemy
speaker: Jesus
note: 10:19 (outside candidate list) hands on authority; K101 (10:20) follows and AUD-46-10-1 holds the sending.

title: Show mercy as the Samaritan did
speaker: Jesus
note: Widens first-pass B21 P02713 (10:30–37) to the lawyer's question 'Who is my neighbor?', which the parable answers.

title: God knows hearts; what people exalt is abomination before Him
speaker: Jesus
note: Rebuke of self-justification before people; no record covers Luke 16:14–17 (K077 and K075 end at 16:13).

title: The kingdom is preached since John, yet no stroke of Law falls
speaker: Jesus
note: Counterparts: Matthew 11:12–13 (first pass links it to AUD-46-7-24) and 5:18 (only Study Context K001). Link there if preferred.

title: Do not seek God's kingdom in visible signs; it is within you
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Pharisees asking when the kingdom comes
note: No record; the warning to the disciples that follows (17:22–25) is AUD-44-24-23.

title: Remember Lot's wife and do not turn back
speaker: Jesus
note: 17:34–35 (one taken, one left) close the same warning; first pass linked Matthew's form (24:40–41) to K083 (B20 P02579).

title: Reject secret or localized claims about the Christ's coming
speaker: Jesus
note: 'Where the body is, there the eagles gather' is Matthew 24:28, inside this record; add beside its Luke 17:22–25 link.

title: God is God of the living; the risen do not marry
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Sadducees, who deny the resurrection
note: Parallel of the Matthew 22:29–32 finding in this batch; 20:35–38 outside candidate list. The question (20:27–33) is linked to S156.

title: Jesus compares the widow's gift with the others
speaker: Jesus
note: Luke's account of the widow's two lepta; same saying as Mark 12:43–44.

title: Do not be led astray or alarmed by wars
speaker: Jesus
note: Widen the Luke 21:8–9 link to 21:8–11, matching Matthew 24:7–8 and Mark 13:8 already inside the record.

title: The council demands Jesus' answer and condemns Him by His own words
speaker: the council of elders, chief priests and scribes
note: Luke's parallel of first-pass B20 P02591/P02660; 'If you are the Christ, tell us' matches the adjuration in Matthew 26:63.

title: Pilate sends Jesus to Herod on learning He is a Galilean
speaker: Pilate
note: Jurisdictional referral found only in Luke; Herod sends Him back (23:11). Custody orders are itemized elsewhere, e.g. first-pass Acts 23:34–35.

title: Rulers, soldiers and a criminal taunt Jesus to save Himself
speaker: the rulers, the soldiers and one of the criminals
note: Parallel of first-pass B20 P02599/P02666 (Matthew 27:39–44, Mark 15:29–32); include only if hostile taunts are recorded.

title: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus' body
speaker: Joseph of Arimathea
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Parallel of first-pass B20 P02668 (Mark 15:42–46); the request itself (23:52) is outside the candidate list.

summary: Ezekiel 36:35–Luke 24:19: 25 new, 12 extend, 7 parallel; main gaps are Zechariah 3:7's charge to Joshua, Ezekiel 46:2–3, unrecorded Gospel teachings (resurrection answer, Luke 16:15–17, 17:20–21), the baptismal anointing, and unlinked Synoptic parallels.
